Read heat strain from the sensor

The Karoo passes on a CORE sensor\'s core and skin temperature, but not the Heat Strain Index the sensor works out itself. With this on, CORE Heat connects to the sensor over Bluetooth to read it, and first checks against the Karoo\'s own reading that it has your sensor and not a riding partner\'s. Until then, or without Bluetooth, the index is estimated from the two temperatures. A CORE takes up to three Bluetooth connections; if yours has none to spare, pair it to the Karoo over ANT+.
